g.text: Closed-loop progression from inpatient admission through blocker discovery, automated chasing, risk elevation, approved action, and safe discharge
Green triage badge in Command Center
• TPA Pre-auth claim initiated with insurer
• Nursing shift change creates pending handoff
• Bed elevated to top of Command Center triage
Orange high-urgency alert visible to staff
• Staff asks: "What is holding up Bed 304?"
• Explains root cause: TPA pre-auth unresponded
UI renders Action Card with Rationale
System waits for authorized staff review
